gameLoop: Sprint across neon rooftops: jump spikes and crates, slide under drones, grab coins, survive as the city scrolls ever faster.

obstacles.role: tall crate; needs a full jump

collectibles: Coin lines and coin arcs over obstacles, 10 points each.
progression: Endless: scroll speed ramps from 280 to 560 px/s while spawn gaps tighten from 600 to 480 px.
scoring: 1 point per meter travelled plus 10 per coin; best run persists locally.
notes: Demo blueprint for the endless-runner template.
